live.what_is_live: 14 container ships declaring Hamburg on AIS and 6 moored at a container quay (position along the quay from AIS); water-level forecasts for 6 Elbe gauges from PEGELONLINE.
live.what_is_not_live: Terminal assignments of inbound ships, crane allocations, box counts per call and yard levels are not published; they are estimated or assumed. AIS does not say whether a cargo ship carries containers; ships without a carrier name that have not been seen at a container quay are left out.

live.tide_note: Tide strip: forecast water level at Hamburg St. Pauli above its mean low water. A tide-dependent ship needs, at every hour it spends between Waltershof and Brunsbuettel, the level at its position (interpolated between the six gauges by Elbe kilometre) above mean low water by its draught beyond the tide-independent limit plus the forecast error at that lead time.

eta_model.reason: 6 matched calls so far; the model starts at 20

baseline_rule: arrival order, every crane each ship can take, no off-dock evacuation

backtest.resolution_note: Observed times come from hourly-to-7-hourly AIS runs and 6-hourly heartbeats, so they are good to a few hours.
